name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

security.umbrella_rule: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only on granular default-deny; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed; umbrellas never cross domains

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: existing-tenant migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants use the same persisted Package 004L split

implemented_workflow: Billing Settings and Tenant Tax Configuration
Credit Note and Exceptional Invoice Void

accounts_receivable.invoice_outstanding_formula: issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations - active write-offs
accounts_receivable.payment_capacity_formula: payment amount - active invoice allocations - active bad-debt recoveries
accounts_receivable.governing_rule: operational receivable and cash facts remain authoritative; reporting, VAT relief and accounting never create mutable shadow balances

package_004k.name: Controlled VAT Bad-Debt Relief
package_004k.boundary: source-linked VAT bad-debt-relief preparation/authorisation/reversal, recovery repayment and VAT-return posting evidence; no direct HMRC submission or GL mutation

package_004l.name: Controlled General-Ledger Posting and Accounting Export Evidence
package_004l.status: executable release candidate validated; final documentation-synchronised head pending release gate

journal_policy.source_evidence: exact source type/public ID/event timestamp/amount/currency plus SHA-256 source fingerprint
journal_policy.idempotency: at most one active non-reversed journal for one source type + source public ID
journal_policy.correction: additive journal_reversal entry; original journal remains immutable

package_004l.concurrency_policy: organisation accounting mutex followed by locking/current source, active-journal and journal-number reads; prevents stale REPEATABLE READ snapshots after a competing poster commits

export_policy.evidence: period, exact journal membership, row count, SHA-256 content checksum, creator/time/reason
export_policy.download_guard: regenerate from persisted links and reject if content checksum differs
export_policy.correction: additive export reversal; original batch remains immutable

deliberate_exclusions: accounting period locks or year-end close
purchase-ledger/AP accounting beyond operational source events

database_types.composition: DatabaseSchema = CoreDB & CollectionsDB & AccountingDB; Database and DatabaseExecutor use the composed schema

validation.generated_kysely_drift: zero across core + collections + accounting outputs
validation.status: final documentation-synchronised Package 004L head must reproduce the complete gate before merge

next_boundary.name: Controlled Accounting Periods and Close Governance
recommended_sequence: define tenant financial-year and accounting-period records
introduce explicit open / soft-closed / hard-closed period states
enforce accounting-date eligibility at posting, reversal and export boundaries
record strong-authority period reopen evidence additively
derive period/trial-balance reporting from immutable journals after governance is stable
keep bank reconciliation, AP expansion, FX and provider-specific accounting integrations as later boundaries
next_boundary.governing_rule: period governance constrains when accounting evidence may be posted; it must never rewrite operational source events or already-posted journal history

open_product_gaps: General/direct contract creation remains absent; current formation is accepted-quotation-derived.
Accepted-quotation conversion edge case remains when the source estimate already has a project but conversion provenance is absent.
Accounting period close/governance is not yet implemented.
Provider-specific accounting integrations, bank reconciliation, purchase-ledger/AP and FX remain later boundaries.
